todo-name-aliases.fixture_note: Both wire spellings of the task tool over one identical synthetic payload (an explicit count of 2), with the composer task panel beneath them derived from a stored `todo_list` history through the production parser `latestComposerTodosFromHistory` (#284). The evidence is that the legacy row and the pinned row are one row: same title, same glyph, same count, same spoken description — `Tool Updated todos, done` is published twice. The panel is a real `ComposerStatusStack` over real `ComposerTodoStatus` rows, not a stand-in. The rows are mounted deliberately because a real turn hoists a task tool out of the transcript entirely, so no live session can show this seam. `desktop_selector` names Desktop's tool-block container. Desktop's half of this capture is source-only: no E2E fixture was identified at `d177b119e9c56c9ddc0b7379ffce52341ec06584` that mounts Desktop's tool block or task panel over synthetic state, so the packet names the pinned `Updated todos` title (`apps/desktop/src/i18n/en.ts:4368`) and the `todo` icon entry (`apps/desktop/src/components/assistant-ui/tool/fallback-model/index.ts:212`) with no companion rendered Desktop pixels rather than inventing a same-pin comparison. The Android row title therefore moves from the old `Todo` fallback to Desktop's `Updated todos` — a deliberate copy change ledgered in `docs/parity/tool-output-fidelity.md`.
